products.name: Kruidvat NewBorn Mini Maat 2 Luiers Midpack
products.description: Premium newborn diapers size 2 (3-6kg) with capture pocket technology and wetness indicator. Dermatologically tested, latex-free, lotion-free and perfume-free. Awarded Best Private Label Product 2025.

products.name: Kruidvat Gold Caramel White Chocolate
products.description: Premium white chocolate with luxurious caramelized flavor. Rich and creamy texture with beautiful golden color from caramelized sugar and milk. Perfect indulgent treat.

products.name: Kruidvat Aloe Vera Hand Soap
products.description: Gentle hand soap with aloe vera gel that doesn't dry out skin. pH skin-neutral formula with fresh spring scent. Keeps hands soft and supple. 500ml pump bottle.

products.name: Food Storage Container with Green Lid
products.description: Clear plastic food storage container with airtight green screw-on lid. Perfect for storing leftovers, meal prep, or dry goods. BPA-free and dishwasher safe.

products.name: Pink Heart Ruler 15cm
products.description: Decorative transparent pink ruler with heart and star patterns. 15cm length with clear measurement markings. Perfect for school, office or crafting projects.

products.name: Sasuage
products.description: High-quality vitamin supplement capsule from Kruidvat's own brand. Orange/brown soft gel capsule containing essential vitamins and minerals. Part of Kruidvat's sustainable packaging initiative.

products.name: Handmade Beaded Bracelet Set - Pastel Colors with star charms
products.description: Beautiful handmade beaded bracelet set with pastel colored beads including pink, purple, blue, and green ceramic and wooden beads. Set of 2 bracelets with elastic band.

products.name: Graphic Design Decorative Patches
products.description: Colorful glitter decorative patches for customizing clothing, bags, or accessories. Multiple colors including pink, blue, gold, and silver glitter finish.

products.name: Colorful Wooden Bead Bracelet
products.description: Vibrant wooden and ceramic bead bracelet featuring blue striped beads, orange ovals, red rounds, yellow spheres, and black accents with yellow cord details.

products.name: Kruidvat Espresso Coffee Capsules
products.description: Premium aluminum coffee capsules, 20 pieces, 100% Arabica beans from South America and Africa. Compatible with Nespresso machines. Intense and versatile flavor with powerful aroma.

products.name: Kruidvat Happy Harmony Shower Gel
products.description: Creamy shower gel with mandarin blossom and cedarwood scent, 300ml. pH-balanced formula for normal skin, leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed with a delightful citrusy-woody fragrance.

products.name: Kruidvat Wild Shampoo with Argan Oil
products.description: Nourishing shampoo enriched with Moroccan argan oil for dry and damaged hair. Helps restore moisture and shine while gently cleansing. Suitable for frequent use.

products.name: Purple Beaded Bracelet
products.description: Elegant purple and lavender beaded bracelet featuring smooth round beads, pink cube accents, golden metallic beads, and small star charms in pink and white.

products.name: Kruidvat Ultra Concentrated Dish Soap
products.description: Ultra concentrated dish soap, 500ml. pH-neutral formula for hands, long-lasting foam action, effectively removes grease and food residue. Lightly perfumed for fresh clean dishes.

products.name: Purple makeup
products.description: Decorative purple bottle cap or closure with embossed floral design. Made from durable plastic material, perfect for craft projects or as a replacement cap.
